card.summary: A free plan is named (portless Minecraft Java hostnames 'on every plan including free'); generic access is planned 'on a paid plan, deliberately'. No price, ...

free_tier.stated: A free plan is named (portless Minecraft Java hostnames 'on every plan including free'); generic access is planned 'on a paid plan, deliberately'. No price, byte allowance or plan table is published, and the beta is waitlist-only.

egress.terms: Nothing is published. The site is a pre-launch waitlist page.; ingress: tcp

record.interface_detail: One small agent dials out; the page names no CLI, API or configuration format.
record.tooling: A Windows app and a single binary are promised; neither is downloadable from the page read.
record.chaining: Would sit between a home service and friends' clients; with no launched product it composes with nothing yet.

limits.value: beta waitlist; no account can be created yet

record.binding_note: There is no product to measure: the gate is the closed beta, and no quota can fail before it opens. The page states generic access is for a paid plan and the free plan is game-hostname oriented, so a free general-purpose tunnel is not planned; no UDP path is named.

identity_cost.detail: Joining the waitlist requires an email address; the page promises no spam.

record.reliability_note: Not operating; nothing can be said about reliability.
record.confidence_note: The waitlist page names no price, allowance or retention window ('The retention window gets published before launch'); the numbers await a launch and a pricing page.

evidence.proved: Pre-beta waitlist page: private relay for services at home, one outbound agent, generic TCP, no ports; no price, no plan, no allowance.
generic (non-game) access is planned for a paid plan, not the free one
evidence.quote: Generic access follows once that's running under real load — on a paid plan, deliberately, so it doesn't become free infrastructure for whoever wants to abuse it.

evidence.proved: the waitlist takes an email address and nothing can be tried before the beta opens
evidence.quote: The beta opens to the waitlist first. Leave an email and you'll hear from us when there's something real to try — not before.

evidence.proved: a free plan is named, and its use named on the page is Minecraft Java hostnames
evidence.quote: Minecraft Java players type it with no port number at all, on every plan including free.

evidence.proved: the beta is waitlist-only and takes an email address
evidence.quote: The beta opens to the waitlist first. Leave an email and you'll hear from us when there's something real to try — not before.

record.notes: Private relay software providing internal network connectivity without exposing public inbound internet ports.

extras.wg_detail: The product page offers generic TCP behind a private relay and names no UDP forwarding and no WireGuard configuration.
extras.volume_stated: Nothing is published. The site is a pre-launch waitlist page.
extras.transit_note: A Kemnir edge relay would carry the bytes.
